AlwaysSuccess.description: Always returns SUCCESS immediately upon execution.

Fallback.description: Returns SUCCESS if any child succeeds. Tries children one by one until one returns SUCCESS.

ForceFailure.description: Executes the child and returns FAILURE regardless of whether the child succeeded or failed.

NavToPose.description: Navigates the robot to a specific 2D pose (x, y, yaw). The 'goal' parameter MUST reference a Blackboard port that stores the target pose. Never pass coordinates or location names directly to NavToPose.

parameters.goal: Input (Blackboard port). The value inside {} must be the Blackboard key, NOT the stored coordinate value.

remarks.goal_parameter: The goal parameter MUST always reference a Blackboard key enclosed in {}.
remarks.blackboard_key: Use the target location name as the Blackboard key whenever possible (e.g. office_room, dock_1, charging_station).
remarks.unknown_coordinates: If the task only specifies a location name without coordinates, assume the corresponding pose has already been stored in the Blackboard using that location name as the key. Do NOT create a SetBlackboard node.
remarks.provided_coordinates: If coordinates are explicitly provided, first store them in the Blackboard using SetBlackboard, then pass the Blackboard key to NavToPose. You must call the tool to learn how to use SetBlackboard node correctly.
remarks.blackboard_value_format: The Blackboard value must be stored as a string in the format 'x;y;yaw' where x, y and yaw are floating-point numbers separated by semicolons.
remarks.blackboard_port_rule: Everything inside {} is a Blackboard key (variable name), never the value stored in the Blackboard.
generation_checklist: If coordinates are provided, create SetBlackboard first.
If coordinates are not provided, assume the Blackboard key already exists.
The goal parameter must always be a Blackboard key enclosed in {}.
Never pass coordinates or location names directly to NavToPose.

Parallel.description: Runs children concurrently and succeeds/fails based on the threshold of children status.

ParallelAll.description: Runs all children concurrently and succeeds only if all succeed, within failure limits.

RetryUntilSuccessful.description: Retries the child if it fails, up to a specific number of attempts.

Sequence.description: Executes children one by one, returning SUCCESS only if all children succeed.

SetBlackboard.description: Writes a value to a specific key in the Blackboard.

remarks.output_key_parameter: The output_key parameter MUST be in string type.

Timeout.description: Aborts child execution and returns FAILURE if the child takes longer than the specified time.
